cd /var/folders/pq/c_ny9d650l5b915rtjcq_sww0000gn/T/tmp.6cyK3OxFMM && python3 -c "
import json, os

m = json.load(open('manifest.json'))

# Models
print('=== MODELS ===')
for k,v in m.get('nodes',{}).items():
    if v.get('resource_type') == 'model':
        cfg = v.get('config',{})
        print(f\"  {v['unique_id']}\")
        print(f\"    materialized: {cfg.get('materialized')}\")
        print(f\"    relation_name: {v.get('relation_name')}\")
        print(f\"    unique_key: {cfg.get('unique_key')}\")
        print(f\"    cluster_by: {cfg.get('cluster_by')}\")
        print(f\"    language: {v.get('language','sql')}\")
        print(f\"    original_file_path: {v.get('original_file_path')}\")
        deps = v.get('depends_on',{}).get('nodes',[])
        print(f\"    depends_on: {deps}\")
        print()

# Sources
print('=== SOURCES ===')
for k,v in m.get('sources',{}).items():
    print(f\"  {v['unique_id']}: relation_name={v.get('relation_name')}\")

# Tests
print()
print('=== TESTS ===')
for k,v in m.get('nodes',{}).items():
    if v.get('resource_type') == 'test':
        print(f\"  {v['unique_id']}: {v.get('test_metadata',{}).get('name','generic')}\")
        deps = v.get('depends_on',{}).get('nodes',[])
        print(f\"    depends_on: {deps}\")

# Child map
print()
print('=== CHILD_MAP (models only) ===')
cm = m.get('child_map',{})
for k in sorted(cm.keys()):
    if k.startswith('model.'):
        print(f\"  {k}: {cm[k]}\")

# Exposures
print()
print('=== EXPOSURES ===')
for k,v in m.get('exposures',{}).items():
    print(f\"  {v['unique_id']}: {v.get('name')}\")
"
